def solve_magic_square():
    s = Solver()
    n = 6
    magic_sum = 111
    
    # Create variables
    x = [[Int(f'x_{i}_{j}') for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    
    # Domain constraints
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            s.add(x[i][j] >= 1, x[i][j] <= n*n)
            
    # All distinct
    s.add(Distinct([x[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)]))
    
    # Row sums
    for i in range(n):
        s.add(Sum([x[i][j] for j in range(n)]) == magic_sum)
        
    # Column sums
    for j in range(n):
        s.add(Sum([x[i][j] for i in range(n)]) == magic_sum)
        
    # Diagonal sums
    s.add(Sum([x[i][i] for i in range(n)]) == magic_sum)
    s.add(Sum([x[i][n-1-i] for i in range(n)]) == magic_sum)
    
    if s.check() == sat:
        m = s.model()
        result = []
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                result.append(m.evaluate(x[i][j]).as_long())
        return result
    else:
        return None
